findings.message: This paragraph starts with a typed number ("3.") instead of a real numbered list. Screen readers do not announce it as a list.
findings.how_to_fix: Select the list paragraphs, apply the List Number style or use the Home tab list button, then delete the typed number.

findings.message: This list mixes typed numbers with automatic numbering. The automatic numbers will not count the typed items, so the numbers can be wrong.
findings.how_to_fix: Delete the typed numbers and apply automatic numbering to the whole list (Home tab > Numbering).
